The '''Apoka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Dohlbani sector/Legends|Dohlbani sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="The Slice" /> It was home to the [[Apokan silveroak]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="Incredible Vehicles" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Apoka system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square R-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
